We've clocked the brand's habit of discounting its legendary 501 silhouette in Prime Day(s) past, but on this very special October version of Amazon's tentpole shopping event—bewilderingly dubbed “Prime Big Deal Days”—Levi's is upping the ante. Sure, the 501 is at an expectedly low price, but the arcuate-stitched denim on sale also includes the relaxed-straight 555 (a sleeper hit among the real 'heads), the Slimane-adjacent 502, and a couple of chinos, for good measure. (If you've pulled on a pair of 555s or 568s recently, you're well aware that the OG dungarees hold up.)

The 501

The big daddy, nay, granddaddy, of denim, the 501 was first introduced in 1890 so that wranglers could avoid the chafing pitfalls of horsehair and desert brush. More than 130 years later and they've tangled with all manner of Hollywood heartthrobs, from Steve McQueen to Kurt Cobain, to become the most instantly recognizable silhouette in denim. While denim diehards may lament the brand's departure from the use of shuttle looms, they still know that for the buck, the bang is up there. The 501 is the silhouette on which so many others have been modeled, and the 100% cotton version—currently on sale for Prime Day—still hits all these decades later.

The 501 Shrink-to-Fit

Levi's

501 Original Shrink-to-Fit Jeans

For the denim obsessive, the 501 Shrink-to-Fit is where things start to get interesting. Cut from rigid denim that's designed to shrink and mold itself to your body over time, it's the closest thing Levi's offers to a participation sport. The process requires a little patience—and perhaps a bathtub—but the payoff is a pair of jeans that feels uniquely yours. They're still classic 501s, just a little more personalized to you than the standard issue.

The 502

Levi's

502 Taper Fit Jeans

The 502 Taper, which is also hovering around 40 bucks on Amazon this week, is the perfect substitute for the man who still mourns his skinny jeans. As the name suggests, it takes a slightly narrower journey from knee to ankle, tapering off to a slim silhouette as it reaches the shoe, making for a lovely vintage combo with a pair of leather boots. Crucially, though, it doesn't cling to the thigh, which anyone over the age of 25 can (and should) appreciate.

The 541

Levi's

541 Athletic Taper Fit Jeans

The 541 Athletic sits somewhere between a straight leg and a taper, making it a great option if you happen to be more muscular through the thighs. With a little more room in the seat and quads, it finishes with a neat full stop of a taper at the ankle, similar to the one made by the 502.

The 555

Levi's

555 Relaxed Straight Fit Jean

The relaxed fit offered up by the 555 is roomier than a straight fit but not as loosey-goosey as a truly baggy pair, making it perfect for someone who wants to embrace the wide-leg vibes of the times without looking like they were waiting in line for a Labubu in 2025.

The 578

The 578 runs contemporary hardware through discount software, putting forward the roomiest of Levi's cuts to wear with a T-shirt that crops at the waistline and a pair of canvas sneakers or some hikers, if you're feeling particularly outdoorsy. Where the 501 is a scoop of chocolate gelato, the 578 is pistachio: almost as popular, and having a moment.

The XX Chino

Levi's

XX Chino Standard Taper Pants

More of a chinos guy? Levi's excellent XX Chino has shown up in a classic straight fit, and it's an easy recommendation for anyone who prefers a dressier alternative to denim. Roomy where it counts and gently narrowed through the lower leg, it strikes a pleasing middle ground between a classic straight fit and something a little more tailored.
